description:
### **Figure Description: EC-HTE vs. Standard Correction Pipeline**

This figure is a sophisticated, publication-quality diagram comparing two data correction pipelines in a clear, two-track layout. It is designed to highlight the superiority of the proposed "EC-HTE" method. The overall aesthetic is clean and professional, adhering to a "Soft Tech" style with a muted pastel palette, softened geometry, and generous whitespace. All text is rendered in a classic serif font for an academic feel.

**1. Overall Layout & Structure**

*   **General Flow:** The diagram follows a left-to-right progression across four conceptual columns: **"Input"**, **"Estimation"**, **"Correction"**, and **"Inference"**.
*   **Comparative Tracks:** The figure is organized into two horizontal "swim lanes" for direct comparison:
    *   **Top Track:** Represents the "Standard Practice," visually coded with a soft, desaturated rose palette to imply a cautionary or problematic approach.
    *   **Bottom Track:** Represents the proposed "EC-HTE (Ours)" method, coded with a calm, professional sage-teal and blue palette to signify an effective solution.
*   **Visual Style:** The overall background is a clean, bright white. All rectangular elements feature consistently rounded corners and subtle drop shadows, lending a soft, modern dimensionality.
*   **Headers:** At the top, bold serif column titles ("Input", "Estimation", "Correction", "Inference") are set in a deep slate gray, anchored by a single, thin horizontal rule below them.

**2. Top Track: "Standard Practice"**

This entire track is unified by a continuous background band of a pale, desaturated rose. A small, bold label in a deep, muted crimson, reading **"Standard"**, is positioned on the far left margin of this band.

*   **Components (Left-to-Right):**
    1.  **Estimation Box:** A rounded rectangle with a white fill and a delicate, muted rose border.
        *   Title: **"Pooled CM Ĉ"** (bold, in deep crimson)
        *   Subtitle: *"One matrix for all"* (italic, in a softer, dusty rose)
    2.  **Correction Box:** A matching white, rounded rectangle with a muted rose border.
        *   Title: **"Global Correction"** (bold, in deep crimson)
        *   Subtitle: *"Ĉ⁻¹ applied uniformly"* (italic, in a softer, dusty rose)
    3.  **Inference Box (Outcome):** Styled to highlight a negative result, this box has a light salmon pink fill and a slightly more pronounced crimson border.
        *   Title: **"Sign Reversal"** (bold, in a strong, warning crimson)
        *   Subtitle: *"14.9% of configs"* (regular, in a muted crimson)
        *   **Badge:** A small, crimson-filled circular badge is placed in the top-right corner, containing a crisp, white '✗' symbol to visually flag an undesirable outcome.

*   **Connections:** Thin, elegant arrows with small, refined heads connect the boxes in sequence: Estimation → Correction → Inference. The arrows are colored in a delicate, dusty rose to match the track's theme.

**3. Bottom Track: "EC-HTE (Ours)"**

This track is contained within a continuous background band of a light, calming sage-teal. A small, bold label in a professional, deep navy blue, reading **"EC-HTE (Ours)"**, is positioned on the far left margin.

*   **Components (Left-to-Right):**
    1.  **Input Column:** Two vertically stacked rounded rectangles with white fills and delicate, sky-blue borders.
        *   **Top Input Box:** Labeled **"LLM Annotations"** (bold, deep navy blue) with the subtitle *"N noisy labels Ẑ"* (italic, softer slate blue).
        *   **Bottom Input Box:** Labeled **"Expert Labels"** (bold, deep navy blue) with the subtitle *"n_expert pairs (Z, Ẑ)"* (italic, softer slate blue).
    2.  **Estimation Box:** A white, rounded rectangle with a confident, medium sage-teal border.
        *   Title: **"Hierarchical Bayes"** (bold, deep navy blue)
        *   Subtitle: *"Per-subgroup CMs {Ĉ_s}"* (italic, clear medium blue)
        *   *Annotation (below box):* A small italic gray text reads: *"Partial pooling · α₀ via Emp. Bayes"*
    3.  **Correction Box:** A white, rounded rectangle with a matching sage-teal border.
        *   Title: **"Per-subgroup Corr."** (bold, deep navy blue)
        *   Subtitle: *"μ̃_s = Ĉ_s⁻¹ · μ̂_s"* (italic, clear medium blue, with clean LaTeX-style math rendering)
        *   *Annotation (below box):* A small italic gray text reads: *"κ-guard: κ > 100 → fallback"*
    4.  **Inference Box (Outcome):** Highlighting the positive result, this box has a soft sky-blue fill and a crisp, medium-blue border.
        *   Title: **"Corrected CATE"** (bold, authoritative navy blue)
        *   Subtitle: *"τ̂(x) ± SE_corr"* (italic, medium blue)
        *   **Badge:** In the top-right corner, a small, rich blue circular badge contains a clean, white '✓' (checkmark) symbol, visually confirming a successful outcome.
        *   *Annotation (below box):* A small italic text in deep navy blue reads: *"via CausalForestDML"*

*   **Connections:**
    *   **Input to Estimation:** Two gracefully curved, solid sage-teal arrows originate from the "LLM Annotations" and "Expert Labels" boxes, converging on the "Hierarchical Bayes" box.
    *   **Main Pipeline:** Straight, solid sage-teal arrows connect the core modules: Estimation → Correction → Inference.
    *   **Cross-Track Connection:** A very light, dashed sage-teal arrow originates from the "Pooled CM" box above and points down to the "Hierarchical Bayes" box. A semi-transparent, italicized sage-teal label reading *"prior"* is placed alongside this arrow, indicating a conceptual link.

**4. Central Separator & Footer**

*   **Separator:** Vertically centered between the two tracks, a subtle, soft gray and bolded **"vs."** explicitly marks the comparison.
*   **Footer:** Positioned at the bottom center of the figure.
    *   **Line 1 (Results):** A bold, deep navy blue line summarizes the key benefits: **"0% sign reversal · |bias| ÷ 7.4"**
    *   **Line 2 (Diagnostic):** A diagnostic formula is presented inside a subtle badge with a warm cream fill and a delicate amber border. The text inside is bold and in a warm amber color: **"Diagnostic (Prop. 2): |δ_s| / ((1-2π̄) · π_s) > 1"**.
